description: This Java source file defines the WidgetFactory class, responsible for managing and instantiating widget components within the OFBiz framework. It loads standard widgets, allows registration of custom widgets, and provides methods to create widget instances based on XML elements.

classes.name: WidgetFactory
classes.description: A utility class for loading, registering, and instantiating widget components based on XML tags within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getModelScreenWidget
methods.description: Creates and returns a ModelScreenWidget instance based on the provided XML element and model screen.

methods.name: loadStandardWidgets
methods.description: Loads the default set of OFBiz widget classes into the factory.

methods.name: registerScreenWidget
methods.description: Registers a widget class with a specific XML tag name for later instantiation.
